text: 证监会同意上海期货交易所热轧卷板、不锈钢期权注册。证监会将督促上海期货交易所做好各项准备工作，确保热轧卷板、不锈钢期权的平稳推出和稳健运行。
text_en: The China Securities Regulatory Commission has approved the registration of hot-rolled coil and stainless steel options on the Shanghai Futures Exchange. The CSRC will urge the exchange to make all preparations to ensure a smooth launch and stable operation of these options.
